label: К
description: Motion toward a person, place, or goal. This pack focuses on going to or toward something or someone.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion toward a target. 1. 'К дому' is dative and means toward the house. 2. 'Иду' is first-person motion on foot. 3. A classic direction sentence with 'к' + dative.

missions.phrase: Подожди, я уже иду к тебе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direction toward a person. 1. 'К тебе' is the dative target person. 2. 'Иду' is first-person motion. 3. Extremely common in everyday spoken Russian.
Strategic focus: Motion toward a person with a role. 1. 'К врачу' is dative and means to the doctor. 2. 'Идёт' is the motion verb. 3. A strong practical survival sentence.
Strategic focus: Motion toward an object. 1. 'К машине' is dative and marks the destination. 2. 'Идём' is plural motion. 3. An easy sentence to picture and type.
Strategic focus: Completed approach. 1. 'Подошла' is a completed motion verb. 2. 'К окну' is dative and marks the destination. 3. Shows 'к' with movement toward a point.
Strategic focus: Plural completed approach. 1. 'Подошли' is plural past. 2. 'К двери' is dative and marks the endpoint of movement. 3. Practical and easy to reuse.
Strategic focus: Ongoing approach. 1. 'Подхожу' is present tense. 2. 'К столу' is dative and marks the thing approached. 3. Contrasts ongoing with completed motion.

missions.phrase: После обеда мы возвращаемся к работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Returning to an activity. 1. 'К работе' is dative and marks what you return to. 2. 'Возвращаемся' is a reflexive motion verb. 3. A useful real-world work phrase.
Strategic focus: Verb-governed dative relation. 1. 'Привык к' is a very common pattern. 2. 'К шуму' is dative and marks what one adapts to. 3. Broadens the meaning of 'к'.
Strategic focus: Preparation toward an event. 1. 'К экзамену' is dative and marks a future target. 2. 'Готовится' is reflexive and common. 3. A very practical student sentence.
Strategic focus: Group preparation. 1. 'К поездке' is dative and marks the upcoming event. 2. 'Готовимся' is first-person plural reflexive. 3. Useful for travel planning.
Strategic focus: Direction toward a place. 1. 'К школе' is dative and means toward the school. 2. 'Идут' is plural motion. 3. Subtly contrasts with 'в школу'.
Strategic focus: Completed past approach. 1. 'Подошёл' is the masculine past form. 2. 'К двери' is dative and marks the endpoint. 3. A strong motion-contrast example.

missions.phrase: Через минуту я подойду к тебе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Future approach. 1. 'Подойду' is future tense. 2. 'К тебе' is dative and marks the target person. 3. Excellent for conversational planning.
Strategic focus: Motion toward a person. 1. 'К другу' is dative and means to a friend. 2. 'Идёт' is motion on foot. 3. Short and highly reusable.
Strategic focus: Completed motion toward a person. 1. 'Пошли' is plural past motion. 2. 'К соседу' is dative and marks the person approached. 3. A common visiting sentence.

missions.phrase: В итоге она пришла к выводу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Fixed abstract phrase. 1. 'К выводу' is dative and means to a conclusion. 2. 'Пришла' is a completed event. 3. Shows 'к' leading into abstract destinations.

missions.phrase: Утром я пришёл к тебе домой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion toward a person and place. 1. 'К тебе' is dative and marks the person. 2. 'Домой' clarifies the destination. 3. Rich but still natural.
Strategic focus: Vehicle motion toward a group. 1. 'К нам' is dative and marks the direction. 2. 'Едут' is vehicle motion, not walking. 3. Ideal for travel and visits.

missions.phrase: Сейчас она идёт к нему на работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direction plus purpose. 1. 'К нему' is the dative target person. 2. 'На работу' adds the purpose context. 3. Combines two movement ideas cleanly.
